title: Averages of Artin characters and their relation to the Davenport--Heilbronn theorem
summary: We bound the error term in the counting function of cubic extensions of $\mathbb{Q}$ by $\mathcal{O}_ε\left(X^{θ+ε}\right)$, with $θ< 2/3$, improving upon results due to Bhargava, Taniguchi, and Thorne. The proof proceeds by relating a certain discriminant-reducing sieve, due to Bhargava, Shankar, and Tsimerman, to averages of Artin characters associated with the Artin $L$-function $ζ_K(s)/ζ(s)$, with $K$ a cubic field.
